verdict.rationale: LM Studio provides its own local server, CLI, and its own agentic app (Bionic), plus MCP server support, but there is no evidence of a single-command feature that launches third-party coding agent CLIs (e.g. Aider, Cursor CLI, Continue) pre-configured to point at local LM Studio models. Evidence covers only LM Studio's own chat/CLI/server tooling, not integration launchers for external agent CLIs.
